To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We have completed the calculation of master-integrals for massless 3-loop form factors.
we have computed all 1,152 three-loop massless propagator diagrams for form factors.
we have completed the computation of all master integrals for the massless three-loop QCD corrections to the quark form factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the computation of the three-loop massless form factors of the QED vertex and the QCD quark-gluon vertex.
the calculation of master-integrals of the three-loop massless form-factors in dimensional regularization.
a calculation of the nine-propagator three-loop massless master integrals for form factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have computed the full set of master integrals required for the massless three-loop QCD form factors.

we provide the complete set of master integrals with the full set of analytic coefficients for the massless three-loop QED form factors, which are the building blocks for the calculation of three-loop corrections to the QED vertex.
we have now computed all master integrals for all massless three-loop Feynman integrals with up to eight propagators.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
all the master integrals are now known in fully analytic form, and the coefficients of the expansion in ϵ can be computed to arbitrary precision.
we have computed 1, 3, and 3 master integrals for two-, three-, and four-point functions respectively, and have given analytic results in the first three cases, and numerical results for the last.
we provide the full set of master integrals needed for massless three-loops calculations in QCD, including the full dependence on the kinematic invariants.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the calculation of master propagator integrals for form factors can be carried out to arbitrary loop order in a fully analytic way.
the number of coefficients in the Laurent series grows very rapidly with the number of propagators, even for integrals which are not expected to be particularly complicated.

the analytic calculation of massless three-loop integrals with up to nine propagators can be performed in terms of Riemann ζ values of weight six and below, and that the analytic results for integrals with more propagators are likely to become more and more complicated.
